paragraphs: PoliceApp runs an online platform for police recruitment, used by applicants looking for law enforcement jobs and by the police departments hiring them. Job seekers search for openings by location or browse police jobs by region. Police departments and associations request a demo to begin using the service, while applicants create an account or search for a job.

The company says the platform was designed by law enforcement professionals and technology experts to remove redundancies and common frustrations from a hiring process it describes as rigorous for applicants and departments alike. Its stated aims are to publicize current law enforcement openings and match candidates with the police jobs they qualify for. It also aims to allow efficient communication between departments and applicants and to create consistency across police departments. The homepage also carries police recruitment and hiring news.
